payload.title: Ship the consent banner on anth.us
payload.description:
As a visitor, I want a clear cookie choice, and as the site owner I want the privacy page and the banner to go live together, so that the published policy is accurate and consent is respected.

Steps: merge and release AnthusAI/Papyrus#366 (PPY-0ac4a9); bump the Papyrus pin here; enable chrome.consent_mode with privacy_policy_url '/privacy/'; add the footer 'Cookie settings' link; publish Anth.us-web#77 (/privacy/) in the same release, since it describes the banner as live.

Acceptance criteria:
Scenario: Strict regions
  Given a visitor in the EEA, UK or Switzerland
  When the page loads and no choice has been made
  Then nothing is stored or sent, as shown in the Tag Assistant consent view
Scenario: Other regions
  Given a visitor outside those regions
  When the page loads
  Then analytics runs and ad signals stay denied until Accept
Scenario: Changing the choice
  Given a visitor has chosen
  When they use the footer 'Cookie settings' link
  Then they can change the choice
Scenario: Policy accuracy
  Given the release is live
  Then /privacy/ and the banner are both live and consistent

Dependencies: Papyrus#366 merged and released; Anth.us-web#77 ready to publish.
